effect: An anvil, made of pure Gold, that's used in the manufacture of high quality products.

items.name: HD Bradium
effect: A high density Bradium used in upgrading weapons. Take this to Mighty Hammer in Eden Group or Payon next to the Kafra Shop Ladies to help you upgrade weapons at +10 and higher.
This Bradium's density guarantees that your weapon will NOT break when attempting to upgrade and if the upgrade attempt fails, it will only downgrade 1 Level instead of 3 like a normal Bradium.

items.name: HD Carnium
effect: A high density Carnium used in upgrading armor. Take this to Mighty Hammer in Eden Group or Payon next to the Kafra Shop Ladies to help you upgrade armor at +10 and higher.
This Carnium's density guarantees that your armor will NOT break when attempting to upgrade and if the upgrade attempt fails, it will only downgrade 1 Level instead of 3 like a normal Carnium.

items.name: HD Elunium
effect: A High Density Elunium that has been buried deep underground.
Used as a material to strengthen armor currently from Refine Levels 7 through 9.
This item's density ensures that Refine attempts will not break the armor and if the attempt fails it will only downgrade by 1.
Only a Blacksmith named Mighty Hammer can use this ore to Refine.

items.name: HD Oridecon
effect: A High Density Oridecon that has been buried deep underground.
Used as a material to strengthen weapons currently from Refine Levels 7 through 9.
This item's density ensures that Refine attempts will not break the weapon and if the attempt fails it will only downgrade by 1.
Only a Blacksmith named Mighty Hammer can use this ore to Refine.

items.name: Oridecon Anvil
effect: An anvil, made of pure Oridecon, that's used to make quality goods.

items.name: Star Dust
effect: Stardust which can form a Star Crumb after being Refined.

items.name: Acorn
effect: A tough, woody shelled nut from an oak tree.

items.name: Alloy Fragment
effect: A broken metal fragment made from an unknown alloy. You've never seen this metal elsewhere, but it seems remarkably prevalent in Verus.

items.name: Aloe
effect: A rare plant with curative properties that only grows deep in the forest during certain times of the year.

items.name: Ancient Lips
effect: A set of fat lips cut from a giant deep sea fish.

items.name: Animal Gore
effect: Bottled blood from a freshly slain beast. It's usually used to lure other animals.

items.name: Animal Skin
effect: Animal hide that can be used in making clothes, coverings or beddings.

items.name: Ant Jaw
effect: A tough, sharp jaw from an ant.

items.name: Antler Helm
effect: A slim helm with stag horns. Can be sold to Item Collectors.

items.name: Armor Piece of Dullahan
effect: A broken piece of armor said to be worn by Dullahan.

items.name: Bandit's Scarf
effect: A red scarf worn by bandits to hide their identity. They all carry these around, but none of them seem to wear them...

items.name: Baphomet Doll
effect: A doll made to resemble Baphomet, enemy of all that is righteous. It is a dollmaker's masterpiece.
Can be traded for 5 Panacea if You bring this doll to <NAVI>Elin<INFO>alberta,117,135,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI> in Alberta.

items.name: Barren Trunk
effect: A tree trunk of wood that is pretty low quality.

items.name: Bat Cage
effect: A cage which is used to hold a bat.

items.name: Battered Kettle
effect: This kettle isn't in the best condition, but it can still be used.

items.name: Bear's Footskin
effect: A lazy bear's foot that supposedly has a unique flavor and the power to restore male vigor.

items.name: Bee Sting
effect: A stinger from a hornet or bee.

items.name: Bill of Birds
effect: A bird's beak. Waste not want not.

items.name: Black Bear Skin
effect: A bad smelling piece of skin peeled from a black bear.

items.name: Black Cat Doll
effect: A doll which resembles a black cat that almost seems alive.

items.name: Black Hair
effect: Lustrous, well brushed hair cut from some virgin.

items.name: Black Ladle
effect: A black colored ladle, made out of an especially strong glowing material.

items.name: Blazing Stone
effect: A fragment of stone infused with incredible heat from deep within the earth. Contains traces of an otherworldly power.

items.name: Blessed Stone
effect: A hell body part of fire golem. Unlike its name, it has bad shape.

items.name: Bloody Coin
effect: A cursed old coin that always seems to be coated in fresh blood, no matter how often it is cleaned.

items.name: Bloody Page
effect: Its surface is marked with old, dried blood stains...

items.name: Bloody Rune
effect: A glowing, blood red rune with ancient writing engraved inside it. It possesses a mysterious power, but one you can't quite understand.

items.name: Blue Bijou
effect: A beautiful blue bijou that is symbolic of the ocean. In the east, people believe that this bijou can help wishes come true.

items.name: Blue Crest Piece
effect: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Blue Hair
effect: Soft, fluffy hair cut from a kobold who is unfortunately no longer with us.

items.name: Bouquet
effect: A bunch of flowers that is given to express love, thanks or appreciation.

items.name: Bradium Fragment
effect: A fragment of Bradium ore, a metal unique to the New World. Unfortunately this sample has too many flaws and impurities to actually be useful.

items.name: Brigan
effect: A red mineral commonly found in the ruins of Glast Heim. It's not clear what causes this mineral to form, but considering the environment there, it can't be anything good.

items.name: Broken Farming Implement
effect: A damaged piece of farm equipment that was once used by the civilians living on Nameless Island.

items.name: Broken Handcuffs
effect: A pair of metal restraints which still seem to smell of blood. For better or worse, they are broken beyond repair.

items.name: Broken Iron
effect: A chunk of broken iron retrieved from a destroyed autonomous robot. Despite its cute little eyes, you're pretty sure it wasn't sentient.

items.name: Broken Petal
effect: A fragmented and colorless petal from an otherworldly flower. The vivid color it once boasted faded the moment it broke off from its source.

items.name: Broken Shell
effect: A damaged turtle's shell. In ancient times, turtle shells were used to foretell the future.

items.name: Broken Shotgun
effect: Just a broken shotgun. A collectible that can be sold to merchant.

items.name: Broken Turtle Shell
effect: A sturdy, solid turtle's shell.

items.name: Broken Urn
effect: A broken urn that once contained the remains of an ancient person. Whatever power drew those remains out of it still lingers inside...

items.name: Brown Rat Tail
effect: A tail of brown rat. A collectible that can be sold to merchant.

items.name: Brown Root
effect: A tree root that still has soil clinging to it.

items.name: Brown Scarf
effect: A brown colored scarf. A necessity for a night watch. A collectible that can be sold to merchant.

items.name: Bug Leg
effect: A hind leg that has been cut from a bug.

items.name: Burning Bug Shell
effect: A very hot insect shell. Very popular because it can be a subtitute for heating pad, you will never feel cold.

items.name: Burning Frill
effect: A frill of Fire Frildora.

items.name: Burning Hair
effect: Bundled scraps of intensely hot fibers that look much like a clump of hair.

items.name: Burnt Part
effect: A burnt out piece of machinery from one of the exceptionally advanced robots built in the Robot Factory.

items.name: Cactus Needle
effect: A sharp needle from a Muka cactus monster.

items.name: Candy
effect: A small piece of candy that looks delicious...but considering the violence it took for you to get your hands on it, you don't feel right eating it.

items.name: Candy Cane
effect: A striped peppermint candy that evokes memories of Christmas. In fact, it evokes them so powerfully, you can't quite bring yourself to eat it.

items.name: China
effect: A clean, white plate crafted by a Chinese master. It's a nice present for the ladies.

items.name: Chonchon Doll
effect: A doll made in the image of a Chonchon monster.
Most people feel a little repulsed by this doll...
Can be traded for a Candy Cane if You bring this doll to <NAVI>Elin<INFO>alberta,117,135,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI> in Alberta.

items.name: Chrysalis
effect: Skin from a larva that has been shed or peeled off.

items.name: Chung Jah
effect: Ancient Korean porcelain made of blue ceramic and crafted by a true master.

items.name: Cinnamon Roll
effect: A delicious cinnamon roll. Not much more to say than that.

items.name: Clam Flesh
effect: Muscular and fatty clam tissue that can be cooked in all sorts of ways.

items.name: Clam Shell
effect: A hard shell taken from a dead clam. Or sometimes from a starfish. Don't ask too many questions.

items.name: Clattering Skull
effect: A remarkably intact skull taken from the zombies populating Nameless Island. So intact, in fact, that it occasionally starts moving again.

items.name: Claw of Desert Wolf
effect: A claw pried from a Desert Wolf's paw.

items.name: Claw of Monkey
effect: A monkey's claw that was used to peel many a banana.

items.name: Claw of Rat
effect: A toe nail from a huge, disease ridden rodent.

items.name: Clean Bone
effect: A small bone.
A collectible that can be sold to merchant.

items.name: Clock Needle
effect: A set of hands taken from the face of a clock.

items.name: Cloud Crumb
effect: A bottle which contains cloud crumbs.

items.name: Clover
effect: A plant with three heart shaped leaves that is plentiful in meadows.

items.name: Coagulated Spell
effect: A crystallization of pure magic found throughout the Kingdom of Glast Heim on the night of its collapse. There is enough energy left in it for it to be turned to another purpose.
items.drops: Nightmare Glast Heim. Talk to the NPC at the Glast Heim entrance, head for the castle and stop just short of the map

items.name: Cobweb
effect: A sticky spider's web made of surprisingly strong threadlike fibers.

items.name: Conch
effect: The shell of a marine mollusk.

items.name: Condensed Darkness
effect: A dark, glassy ball left behind by the cosmic entities inhabiting the top levels of the Astral Tower.

items.name: Congealed Darkness
effect: A small lump of dark, unidentifiable matter. Its very existence seems to deny everything you know about the physical world.

items.name: Contaminated Ash
effect: A dark pile of ash contaminated by pollution from industrial enterprises.

items.name: Contorted Self-Portrait
effect: A self-portrait of someone contorting his facial expression.

items.name: Crab Shell
effect: A hard shell taken from a rather tough little crab.

items.name: Cracked Diamond
effect: A damaged diamond with obvious imperfections that won't sell for much zeny.

items.name: Crimson Feather
effect: A large feather with a sinister red gleam. You can't help but feel that the "angel" it came from was anything but.

items.name: Crude Scimitar
effect: A rusty old scimitar. It seems may break at any moment. A collectible that can be sold to merchant.

items.name: Crystal Fragment
effect: A small piece of a pretty crystal that looks like it has a symbol of an eye in its center.

items.name: Crystal Mirror
effect: A gorgeous mirror made with polished crystal that is considered an essential for every woman.

items.name: Crystalline Teardrop
effect: A crystalline teardrop shed by an Aqua Elemental in its final moments.

items.name: Cursed Water
effect: A vial containing cursed water that can be found all over Geffenia. Even thousands of years after its collapse, the curse that destroyed that nation still runs strong.

items.name: Cyfar
effect: A strange blue crystal formed in the bodies of some monsters.

items.name: Daenggie
effect: A braided pigtail that has been cut from the head of a young girl.

items.name: Dark Mask
effect: A dark mask used to cover the face and conceal the identity of the wearer, made famous by its use by the Amatsu Clan's precursors.

items.name: Dawn Blossom
effect: A vibrant pink flower that blooms only in the vicinity of the Tower of the Morning in Eclage.

items.name: Dawn Grass
effect: A lush green he rb that blooms only in the vicinity of the Tower of the Morning in Eclage.

items.name: Dead Medusa
effect: A Medusa's head that, naturally, looks pretty sad and depressed.

items.name: Decayed Nail
effect: A putrid, incredibly pungent corpse's nail.

items.name: Decomposed Rope
effect: A length of old, rotten rope that was once used to hang something decidedly unpleasant, judging by the reddish brown stains still lingering on it.

items.name: Delicious Stem
effect: Quite primitive form of plant stem. It feels warm inside it. Very popular because of its taste!

items.name: Dented Iron Plate
effect: A damaged piece of metal taken from a highly advanced machine.

items.name: Denture from Dragon Mask
effect: A tooth cut from a dragon mask. It seems to be made from a different material than the rest of the mask, which is wooden.

items.name: Desert Pear
effect: A mysterious fruit found only in the arid plateaus around Veins. The plants they grow on are incredibly hard to find, but the monsters that live there survive by ferreting them out, and so can often be found carrying their fruit around.

items.name: Dokebi Horn
effect: Horns from a Dokebi which are rumored to bring great fortune to their owner.

items.name: Dragon Bone
effect: A small bone taken from the body of a dragon that was steeped in the Nightmare.

items.name: Dragon Canine
effect: A viciously sharp fang wrenched from the jaw of a large dragon. It's sharp enough you could almost use it as a weapon just as it is.

items.name: Dragon Horn
effect: A decorative horn from a dragon mask.

items.name: Dragon Scale
effect: An iridescent dragon's scale that is tough enough to protect from weather and most forms of harm.

items.name: Dragon Skin
effect: A piece of skin from a dragon.

items.name: Dried Bone
effect: A dessicated bone that is incredibly dry despite coming from a remarkably wet place.

items.name: Dry Sand
effect: Dry sand which can be easily found on the street.

items.name: Dust Pollutant
effect: A clump of small, dry particles that can commonly be found clinging to just about anything in the Einbroch area.

items.name: Earthworm Peeling
effect: A shed skin peeling from an Earthworm.

items.name: Ectoplasm
effect: Green translucent liquid that is disgustingly sticky.

items.name: Elastic Band
effect: An amazing length of flexible material which returns to its original form after being stretched.

items.name: Empty Orb
effect: A small glass orb that looks like it might have once been used for magical purposes, but now is entirely void of energy.

items.name: Empty Potion Bottle
effect: An empty bottle that can be used to contain potions.

items.name: Empty Test Tube
effect: An empty test tube that can be used to contain some kind of solution.

items.name: Evil Horn
effect: Baphomet's horn is a symbol representing evil.
Can be traded for an Antler if You bring 20 of this to <NAVI>Cherokee<INFO>122,53,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI> in Alberta.

items.name: False Angel Wing
effect: A wing from a phony angel.

items.name: False Heaven Ring
effect: A heavenly halo from a phony angel.

items.name: Fang
effect: A sharp cuspid yanked from some monster's mouth.

items.name: Feather
effect: A feather that boasts full, lustrous barbs used for making clothes of the highest quality.

items.name: Feather of Birds
effect: A bird's feather that can be used in decor or in fabric creation.

items.name: Festival Mask
effect: A mask that is worn during festivals.

items.name: Fin
effect: A fish monster's fin.

items.name: Fine Grit
effect: A crystal made entirely of fine sand.

items.name: Fine-grained Trunk
effect: A tree trunk of wood with an excellent grain.

items.name: Fish Tail
effect: A tail severed from a fish monster.

items.name: Flashlight
effect: A flashlight that used to be attached to a miner's helmet.

items.name: Flexible Tube
effect: A long, thin, pipe-like tube made to transport liquids or gases.

items.name: Flower
effect: An ordinary, thornless wildflower that doesn't have any particular scent.

items.name: Fluff
effect: A clump of monster fur and fuzz that can be used to make thread and fabric.

items.name: Fluorescent Liquid
effect: A sticky, flourescent liquid which glows in the darkness.

items.name: Folding Fan of Cat Ghost
effect: A folding fan which is very useful in summer.

items.name: Fragment
effect: A strange object with metal pieces attached to it. It could be a piece of a very large machine.

items.name: Fragment of Darkness
effect: A piece of stone formed of condensed darkness, created by the lingering effects of the curse that doomed the ancient kingdom of Glast Heim. Just holding it in your hands engenders feelings of despair.

items.name: Fresh Fish
effect: A fresh fish that can be cooked in a variety of ways. Quite popular among cats.

items.name: Frigid Liquid
effect: A pool of exceptionally cold fluid that absolutely refuses to freeze solid.

items.name: Frill
effect: Some skin from the neck of a lizard which lives in the desert.

items.name: Frostwind Feather
effect: A large grey feather taken from a Frostwind, one of the enormous birds native to the Far North.

items.name: Frozen Rose
effect: Sculpted out of ice by masters in the Arctic, this unique and beautiful rose makes a great gift.

items.name: Frozen Stone
effect: An amalgamated stone that is so cold and hard, it is virtually indistinguishable from ice.

items.name: Fur
effect: Beautiful Silver colored fur that can be sold to merchant NPCs at a high price.

items.name: Garlet
effect: A small crystallization created by some monsters.

items.name: Ghostly Essence
effect: A strange substance left behind by the ghostly wanderers in the Labyrinth Forest. Were it not for this, you might be fooled into believing they had been real people once.

items.name: Ghostly Grass
effect: A mysterious, ephemeral plant found only in the Hazy Forest. It seems like it might fade from existence at any moment.

items.name: Gill
effect: Part of a fish's breathing apparatus.

items.name: Glast Decayed Nail
effect: Surprisingly clean nails from the monsters of Glast Heim's past.

items.name: Glast Horrendous Mouth
effect: Teeth from the monsters of Glast Heim's past.

items.name: Glossy Hair
effect: A tied bunch of shining human hair.

items.name: Goat Skin
effect: Skin and hair taken from a wild goat.

items.name: Gold Bullion
effect: A bar of pure gold which can be used as currency.

items.name: Golden Hair
effect: A beautiful lock of golden human hair.

items.name: Grasshopper's Leg
effect: A Rocker's hind leg.

items.name: Grave Dust
effect: Dust collected from inside the Capitolina Catacombs. Contains faint traces of an otherworldly power.

items.name: Green Bijou
effect: A beautiful green bijou that is symbolic of the earth. In the east, people believe that this bijou can help wishes come true.

items.name: Green Crest Piece
effect: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Green Pitaya Tail
effect: A tail cut from a Green Pitaya. It looks...and tastes strangely like a fruit.

items.name: Grit
effect: A speck of dust found in the dark recesses of some dungeon.

items.name: Gunpowder
effect: Explosive powder.

items.name: Hard Feeler
effect: A sharp, solid feeler.

items.name: Harpy Feather
effect: A feather from a Harpy. The Harpy's wings are effective in paralyzing its enemies.

items.name: Heart of Mermaid
effect: The heart of a mermaid.

items.name: Hebian Leaf
effect: A strange leaf that the Hebians always seem to carry around with them. You only ever see them around the Serpentine Temple. Are they guardians there...or invaders?

items.name: Helm of Dullahan
effect: A helm that is said to be worn by Dullahan.

items.name: Hill Wind Talon
effect: A Talon from a Hill Wind.

items.name: Honey Pot
effect: An empty pot that carried honey once upon a time, but contains sweet goodness no longer.

items.name: Horn of Hillslion
effect: A hard horn that grows on Hillslion's head.

items.name: Horrendous Hair
effect: Some of Medusa's hair, which is essentially just a bunch of snakes.

items.name: Horrendous Mouth
effect: A grotesque collection of teeth collected from a corpse that was a bit too lively for comfort. You can only hope these will stay quiet now.

items.name: Horseshoe
effect: A "U" shaped piece of iron fitted on a horse's hoof for its protection.

items.name: Hung Doll
effect: A doll hung on a rope that appears to hold some sort of cursed spell.

items.name: Ice Chunk
effect: A mysterious lump of ice that wil never melt. You can probably thank Christmas Magic for this unnatural abomination.

items.name: Icewind Feather
effect: A large white feather taken from an Icewind, one of the enormous birds native to the Far North.

items.name: ID Card
effect: A small identification card belonging to security workers in Rekember's secret Somatology Laboratory.

items.name: Insect Feeler
effect: Antennae that serve as sense organs for insects.

items.name: Jack o' Pumpkin
effect: A pumpkin with a carved, spooky face.

items.name: Jade Bead
effect: A small bead of pure jade that looks like the eye of a cat, presented as an offering for the departed soul of the person laid to rest in the Forgotten Tomb.

items.name: Jellopy
effect: A small crystallization created by some monsters.

items.name: Jubilee
effect: A crystallization, dropped from monsters, whose name means joyous celebration.

items.name: Jungle Leaf
effect: A huge leaf native to the Umbala Jungle.

items.name: Jungle Vine
effect: A sturdy length of vine commonly found in the Umbala Jungle.

items.name: Lamp
effect: A beautiful lamp made with red paper.

items.name: Lantern
effect: A carriable case with glass panes that allow some contained light to illuminate dark areas.

items.name: Large Scaraba Helmet
effect: A sturdy helm worn by the larger Scaraba soldiers. It displays an alarming level of artifice for a race of insects.

items.name: Leaf Bookmark
effect: An old leaf once used as a bookmark in an ancient magical grimoire. Though you are curious what it was marking, you unfortunately had to dispatch with the grimoire in question to get this.

items.name: Leopard Skin
effect: Peeled off leopard skin. There is a rumor of a man who ruled the jungle, wearing this skin as a loincloth.

items.name: Little Evil Horn
effect: Horns sliced off the head of a little demon.

items.name: Little Ghost Doll
effect: A kind of spirit that has a red ribbon on its head.

items.name: Living Wood
effect: A block of wood from a tree that's still trying to grow, despite being cut down.
items.drops: Greatest General on pay_fild10, or from other players in Prontera

items.name: Loyalist Mark
effect: A mark given to soldiers of the Rachel Army as a reward for their loyalty to the Temple. Possessing this means it was taken rather forcibly from a loyalist, something the Veins Rebels would be happy to reward you for.

items.name: Magma Jelly
effect: A soft gel formed by the intense heat of Thor's Volcano. Despite it's name, it's actually cool enough to touch with your bare hands.

items.name: Mane
effect: Bristly, tough hair cut from a wild boar.

items.name: Maneater Blossom
effect: A carnivorous flower with a digestive system very much like the humans.

items.name: Maneater Root
effect: Roots, which resemble human legs, that almost look capable of walking.

items.name: Mantis Scythe
effect: A sharp, front limb severed from a Mantis.

items.name: Mantis Shell
effect: The hardened shell of a mantis was mutated by exposure to tremendous levels of poison.

items.name: Mastela Fruit
effect: A shiny, purple fruit once renowned for its almost miraculous healing properties. Unfortunately, the curse that brought down the civilization of Geffenia still lingers on it, making it exceptionally deadly if consumed.

items.name: Ment
effect: A white flower containing oils that can relieve pain and aches. Strangely, only a few remember how to use it to cause memory loss.

items.name: Mole Claw
effect: A mole's claw that is sturdy enough to dig into the ground.

items.name: Mole Whiskers
effect: Whiskers from a mole. They smell vaguely of...tobacco?

items.name: Monster's Blood
effect: A bottle containing blood from monster of Flaming Basin. It's not clear whether if drinking it will harm or not.

items.name: Moth Dust
effect: Bottled powder from the wings of a moth.

items.name: Moth Wings
effect: A set of wings cut from a moth.

items.name: Mould Powder
effect: A handful of soft, powdery mold that is strangely silken to the touch.

items.name: Mud Lump
effect: A lump of wet mud kept soft and moist by the spiritual energies lingering about the Forgotten Tomb.

items.name: Munak Doll
effect: A doll made in the appearance of a young girl.

items.name: Mushroom Spore
effect: A spore discharged from a mushroom.

items.name: Mutated Scale
effect: A scale taken from one of the creatures in the Rgan Tunnels in the Far North. This one was taken from a Rgan that had yet to fully transform.

items.name: Mysterious Emblem
effect: An emblem representing an organization you don't recognize.

items.name: Mysterious Ore
effect: A fragment of mysterious purple ore found in the heart of Thor's Volcano. It seems critical to whatever was being researched in the secret military base there.

items.name: Mystic Horn
effect: A long, white horn harvested from the Cornus roaming Splendide Fields.

items.name: Mythril Ore
effect: An ore containing mythril which can be purified to make mythril.

items.name: Naga Scale
effect: A scale taken from one of the Naga roaming the Splendide Fields.

items.name: Necklace of Oblivion
effect: A necklace given to assassins of unparalleled skill working with the Veins Rebels. Not even the gods can ignore someone capable enough to earn this honor. The Rachel Temple would lavishly reward anyone capable of handing this token over to them.

items.name: Needle Packet
effect: A packet, made with fabric, that is used to hold needles in place.

items.name: Nipper
effect: A crustacean's claw.

items.name: Nose Ring
effect: A ring placed in a cow's nose so that it can be steered more easily.

items.name: Obsidian Fragment
effect: A sharp, shiny fragment broken off a dark crystal.

items.name: Oil Paper
effect: A piece of yellowish paper with a waxy surface that repels water.

items.name: Old Frying Pan
effect: An old frying pan that has outlived its usefulness.

items.name: Old Magic Book
effect: A spell book containing powerful, ancient magic.

items.name: Old Manteau
effect: A old, exhausted manteau.

items.name: Old Pick
effect: An old, worn out pick that had been picked up by monsters to do...whatever monsters do when there are no adventurers around.

items.name: Old Portrait
effect: An old, fragile portrait of a girl that you can't quite identify, although she seems very pretty.

items.name: Old Revolver
effect: A rusty old revolver. A collectible that can be sold to merchant.

items.name: Orange
effect: A sweet citrus fruit native to the Comodo region.

items.name: Orange Crest Piece
effect: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Orc Claw
effect: A thick, sharpened fingernail from an Orc.

items.name: Orcish Voucher
effect: A small sculpture that serves as the token for every true Orc Warrior.

items.name: Osiris Doll
effect: A doll made to resemble Osiris, king of darkness. Without a doubt, it is a dollmaker's masterpiece.
Can be traded for 2 Fruit of Mastela if You bring this doll to <NAVI>Elin<INFO>alberta,117,135,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI> in Alberta.

items.name: Peaked Hat
effect: A small, red colored peaked hat that can be sold to merchant NPCs at a high price.

items.name: PecoPeco Feather
effect: A rare feather from the wing of a Peco Peco.

items.name: Pellet
effect: A small, round pill that looks like it will taste bitter.

items.name: Pencil Case
effect: A case for containing pencils. It'd be a nice gift for artists, writers, students and the like

items.name: Piece of Bamboo
effect: A piece of bamboo from a bamboo tree, an otherwise rare plant that grows in great abundance in Amatsu.

items.name: Piece of Black Cloth
effect: A piece of jet black cloth that cannot be seen in the dark.

items.name: Piece of Egg Shell
effect: An eggshell fragment that protected its egg to the final, tragic end.

items.name: Pinafore
effect: A soft cloth which is worn around the neck of an infant to protect the chest from spilled milk and baby drool.

items.name: Pincher of Beetle
effect: A pincher from a beetle.

items.name: Platinum Bullion
effect: A bar of pure platinum. Platinum is a very rare metal and is more valuable than gold.

items.name: Pointed Scale
effect: A single scale from a Worm Tail monster.

items.name: Poisonous Powder
effect: A bottle of poisonous powder which may poison enemies when mixed with water or alcohol.

items.name: Poisonous Toad Skin
effect: A piece of skin from the back of a poisonous toad.

items.name: Porcupine Quill
effect: Sharp, hollow quills which used to cover and protect some porcupine.

items.name: Poring Doll

effect: It looks like normal canned food but the surface is rusted here and there. It actually grosses you out.

items.name: Poor Can Sack
effect: Sack full of poor quality canned food. It's actual purpose is suspicious...

items.name: Poring Scourer
effect: The ultimate cleaning mop for cleaning a kitchen. Rub a few times on stricken oil.

items.name: Portable Sewing Kit
effect: It seems has been treasured for a long time. This leather case contain some needles, thread and buttons.
<NAVI>Hunter Serin<INFO>payon_in03,194,39,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

items.name: Power Control Device
effect: All the machines found in Phantasmagorika have this component installed in the center of their mechanisms. The Excavation Team has named it the Power Control Device.

items.name: Prisoner's Letter
effect: A letter for prisoner's acquaintance. It has many stories written on it.

items.name: Purple ore
effect: An ore that radiates strange light. It's flowed with magic.

items.name: Purple Ore Box
effect: A box full of purple ores.

items.name: Rare Tome
effect: An old book from a long time ago. Already out of print since a long time ago, a 5 rated star book people says.

items.name: Receipt
effect: A receipt from a shop in Juno. There's a signature which looks like it was signed by Maestro Song".

items.name: Record Fragment
effect: Shard of a Memory Record found in the laboratories. Shards were only left after it broke when being decoded. A strange energy of it being pulled somewhere can be felt.

items.name: Record of Ancient Language
effect: Paper with writing in an ancient language obtained from "Sobbing Starlight".

items.name: Red Eye
effect: Shiny red eye of a monster. Its sparkling favourited by monster.

items.name: Red Key
effect: A thin, transparent and shining red key.

items.name: Red Reagent
effect: A red colored reagent.

items.name: Report on Manuk
effect: Report from Manuk expedition in order to brief atmosphere in Manuk. Every details about Manuk were written.

items.name: Report on Splendide
effect: Report from Splendide expedition in order to brief atmosphere in Splendide. Every details about Splendide were written.

items.name: Research Tool Bag
effect: A bag that contains all the research tools used by researchers.

items.name: Rough Mineral
effect: Roughly collected ore.

items.name: Rune Magic Powder
effect: A mysterious powder that has rune power, it can grant enchanted spell.

items.name: Rune Midgard History Book
effect: A book contain histories of Rune Midgard. 12 volumes published so far.

items.name: Sacred Rosary
effect: A blessed Rosary. It can distiguish whether dead and alive. Disappears after event period.

items.name: Saint's Clothing Piece
effect: Traces of a cloth which has been worn by a Saint.

items.name: Sample of New Project Item
effect: A sample of under development new item of co-development of Roegen Hamburg Van Wolff and Wigner Van Isaac.

items.name: Sample of Puddle Research
effect: A sample of puddle water, taken to study the bath in Mora Village.

items.name: Sapha Certification
effect: A certificate given by Sapha leaders for meritorious deeds.

items.name: Scale Sample
effect: A scale sample thought to be from the unidentified creature in the mysterious bath in Mora Village.

items.name: Scouting Report 1
effect: A written report from a Steel Wings scout reporting his findings in the Far North Frozen Canyons. Once you have all three, these should be returned to the Steel Wings Officer at the Frozen Shore.

items.name: Scouting Report 2
effect: A written report from a Steel Wings scout reporting his findings in the Far North Frozen Canyons. Once you have all three, these should be returned to the Steel Wings Officer at the Frozen Shore.

items.name: Scouting Report 3
effect: A written report from a Steel Wings scout reporting his findings in the Far North Frozen Canyons. Once you have all three, these should be returned to the Steel Wings Officer at the Frozen Shore.

items.name: Seal Stamped Letter
effect: A sealed letter with stamp of royal family.

items.name: Seed For Experiemnt
effect: An altered seed which is influenced by external factors. Nobody knows what kind of plant will bloom from it.

items.name: Shaggy Muffler
effect: A Muffler made out of unacquainted materials and techniques. It is the Manuk Sapha tribe's favorite muffler. It's worn out. The name is inscribed on the tip of the muffler.

items.name: Shattered Magic Stone
effect: A piece of magic stone. It seems like some special people need it.

items.name: Shipment Box
effect: A box of nondescript, miscellaneous goods packaged and ready for shipment. Definitely nothing suspicious here.

items.name: Silvervine Cat Fruit
effect: Silvervine cat fruit. There is a fruit with a fragrance that puts it on another Level. It's very rare form too far to understand.

items.name: Small Pocket
effect: A small pocket dropped by a Lapine. It contains something.

items.name: Special Medal
effect: A medal from winning a monster race. Can be exchanged with something.

items.name: Spirit of Alfheim
effect: Perfume made from distilled flowers of Alfheim. It smells cozy and nostalgic.

items.name: Spirit Piece
effect: A piece of a soul's spirit that refuses to rest in peace.

items.name: Spiritual Whispers
effect: A curious object that almost seems alive, especially since it faintly whispers to you.

items.name: Star of Blessing
effect: A little gem engraved with royal family of Prontera kingdom "Tera Gloria" symbol. It was made from the piece of Heart of Ymir and used in blessing ceremony 'Star of Blessing'.

items.name: Strange Magic Stone
effect: Mineral with an odd pulse similar to the dimensional crack. You sense a magic that is not of this world from it.

items.name: The Sign
effect: A voucher that allows entrance into Valhalla.

items.name: Token of Union
effect: A certified investment slip of Rune Midgard metropolitan. Returning it to the investor will give you a trust from metropolist.

items.name: Tooth Sample
effect: A tooth sample thought to be from the unidentified creature in the mysterious bath in Mora Village.

items.name: Top Secret Document
effect: A document to report secret information. For security reason, it locked with magic.

items.name: Tranquil Energy Fragment
effect: A fragment of energy that somehow losses it's power.
Can be obtained from 1st -2nd floor of Bio Lab.

items.name: Translated Ancient Language
effect: The door leading to the great power can be found under the twilight sky from the tower of the heaven. The key to the door will be the grass living under the Sun.

items.name: Unknown Test Tube
effect: A test tube that contains some sort of unidentified fluid.

items.name: Unstable Energy Fragment
effect: A fragment of energy that weak and unstable, may perish in any moment.
Can be obtained from 3th floor of Bio Lab.

items.name: Vermillion Keycard
effect: A flat, translucent red keycard with no obvious markings on it to indicate where it should be used. Something about the colour leaves a somewhat sinister impression on you.

items.name: Voucher
effect: A delivery voucher with the serial number: 2485741

items.name: Weak Energy Fragment
effect: A fragment of energy that just created.
Can be obtained from 1st -2nd floor of Bio Lab.

items.name: Witch's Medal
effect: A medal rewarded to honorable witches.

items.name: Witch's Spell Scroll
effect: A worn out scroll with illegible text written in an ancient language. The only word you can read is "Kirkana".

items.name: Witch's Tonic
effect: An enchanted tonic that causes the loss of key memories of your past.

items.name: Wood
effect: Good quality wood. It makes the wooden building it is a tightly good lumber.

items.name: Wooden Rosary
effect: A crude rosary made from wood.
<NAVI>Sister Margaretha<INFO>prt_monk,93,254,0,100,0,0</INFO></NAVI>

items.name: Yellow Key
effect: A thin, transparent and shining yellow key.

items.name: Yggdrasilid Key
effect: A shining golden key that was ostensibly given to the Raffles by the Yggdrasilids in case of emergency. It has now been recharged, and is capable of taking you to the place where the Yggdrasilids are waiting.

items.name: Elunium
effect: A rare metal that can be used to strengthen and refine high level armors.

items.name: Emveretarcon
effect: A metal that can be used to strengthen and Refine mid-level weapons.

items.name: Iron
effect: A common, durable metal that can be used to strengthen and Refine low level armors.

items.name: Nightmare Chunk
effect: A large chunk of material suffused with the distorting energies present in Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv130 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Dust
effect: Tiny fragments, no more than dust really, that are charged with the distorting energies that suffuse the Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv70 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Fragment
effect: Decent sized fragments of crystal suffused with the distorting energies present in Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv110 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Shard
effect: A remarkably intact shard of crystal suffused with the distorting energies present in Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine specialized Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Sliver
effect: Tiny slivers charged with the distorting energies that suffuse the Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv90 Shadow Gear

items.name: Oridecon
effect: A rare metal that can be used to strengthen and refine high level weapons.

items.name: Phracon
effect: A metal that can be used to strengthen and Refine low level weapons.

items.name: Steel
effect: An iron and carbon alloy known for its structural durability. Can be used to refine mid-level armors.

items.name: Alice's Apron
effect: An apron worn by Alice. Her movements are so lifelike, it's hard to believe she's only a mechanical doll.

items.name: Amethyst
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Prontera Field 0...?

items.name: Amulet
effect: A forbidden talisman that can reanimate the dead, resulting in a walking corpse or undead zombie.

items.name: Ancient Coin
effect: An ancient golden coin. It's too old to be used as actual currency anymore...and honestly probably too valuable.

items.name: Ancient Hair Ornament
effect: A hair accessory, said to have been worn by an ancient queen. Whoever it once belonged to, it found its way to Maya Purple.
Maybe there is some use for it in Ant Hell 2...?

items.name: Ancient Tooth
effect: A sharp, serrated tooth pulled from the mouth of a giant deep sea fish.

items.name: Angelic Feather
effect: A feather radiating holy power. When you hold it in your hands, you can't help but feel drawn to the Payon Forest...

items.name: Apostle's Token
effect: A token belonging to the Apostle of Baphomet, found in the Capitolina Catacombs. In its last moments, did it ever realize the evil it chose to worship had been supplanted by another...?

items.name: Aquamarine
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars. This one, however, doesn't seem to have much use.

items.name: Astral Crystal
effect: A crystalline fragment broken off of the Astral Guardian, an otherworldly construct protecting the lower levels of the Astral Tower.

items.name: Baron's Cane
effect: A sturdy cane wielded by the Owl Baron that took up residence in Thanatos Tower's lower level. It has an air of sophistication that you wouldn't normally expect from monsters.

items.name: Blade Lost in Darkness
effect: A blade taken from the cursed sword Mysteltainn that roams Geffenia. It seems to be absorbing the light from the world around you.

items.name: Blazing Ruby
effect: A ruby cloaked in eternal fire plucked from the remains of a Flux Titan. Something deep in the Magma Caverns must be transforming these monsters...is this jewel a clue?

items.name: Blood Thirst
effect: The condensed physical form of the intense blood lust of the heroes lost to Rekember's somatology research. There is no quenching the thirst for revenge in those already departed.

items.name: Bloody Edge
effect: A broken edge from the cursed sword Tirfing that roams Geffenia. It is perpetually coated in blood that never dries.

items.name: Blue Pitaya Tail
effect: The tail of a Blue Pitaya. Exceptionally rare, considering that Blue Pitayas don't exist.

items.name: Broken Crown
effect: A broken crown that once belonged to the monarch of a very familiar kingdom. But what was he...or rather, his corpse, doing on Nameless Island...?

items.name: Broken Engine
effect: A damaged machine that was once part of an ancient robot's motor system.

items.name: Broken Gun
effect: A broken handgun once used by a commando defending the Rebel Fortress in north Schwarzwald.

items.name: Broken Hieroglyph
effect: A broken tablet bearing partial, and thus illegible hieroglyphic writing. Not that you could read it if it wasn't broken.

items.name: Broken Inscription
effect: A broken piece of stone with writing carved in an otherworldly language. You can only wonder what it describes...or where it came from.

items.name: Broken Needle
effect: Pieces of a sewing needle that have broken in two. Something about this needle feels off...like it's somehow aware of you.

items.name: Broken Trident
effect: The spear wielded by the king of the abyss. Unfortunately it was damaged in the fighting, and so won't be useful in combat anymore.

items.name: Bulgasari Leather
effect: Thick, fire hardened leather from the massive Bulgasari living in the depths of Thor's Volcano.

items.name: Burning Horseshoe
effect: A burning horseshoe. Should probably only be shod on a burning horse.

items.name: Burning Jewel
effect: A jewel infused with the intense heat of a volcano. This crystallization itself marks one's mastery over that fire.

items.name: Burning Shard
effect: A shard made of an unknown material that is perpetually searing hot, no matter how long it has to cool.

items.name: Burnt Wood
effect: A chunk of wood that was partially burned in a stove. Considering how angry that stove was when you found it, it's pretty strange it survived in such good condition.

items.name: Captured Gas
effect: Captured gas from a living Pollution Elemental. You can only imagine what kind of havoc it would wreak if you opened this bag.

items.name: Celestial Fabric
effect: A piece of heavenly fabric from which the spirits weave their clothing.

items.name: Chimera Sculpture
effect: An idol carved in a shape reminiscent of a Chimera. You can only hope that whoever once revered this awful creature is long gone.

items.name: Chivalry Emblem
effect: A symbol given by a lord to one of his knights as a mark of their unfailing trust. Only the most loyal knights are granted this honor.

items.name: Citrin
effect: A rare mineral with a yellow, jewel-like sheen. Symbolizes communicative conversation and mental calm.

items.name: Coal
effect: A black mineral used for processing iron into steel. Critical fuel for the revolution. The Goblin revolution.

items.name: Coal Powder
effect: A pile of coal from a massive coal elemental. Unfortunately it had to be reduced to powder to stop it from attacking you.

items.name: Contaminated Magic
effect: Twisted, corrupting magic condensed into a physical form. Whoever was responsible for doing this to Glast Heim, it seems this is the only evidence of them left in this twisted echo of that day.

items.name: Contract in Shadow
effect: A contract made with the realm of Darkness. It's written in a language you can't understand.

items.name: Coral Bangle
effect: A small bracelet of polished coral worn by the worshipers in the Rgan Sacred Ground. It denotes those who have been given the authority to bestow the World Serpent's blessing.

items.name: Coral Reef
effect: A small chunk of a reef formed by corals in clear, tropical waters.

items.name: Cosmic Fragment
effect: A large, jewel-like sphere that thrums with barely contained cosmic energy. It feels disturbingly alien.

items.name: Crystal of Agony
effect: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Not even those who died to Morroc's rampage knew relief, their souls tormented even in the afterlife.

items.name: Crystal of Despair
effect: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Morroc's name alone was enough to smother the hopes and dreams of those in his path.

items.name: Crystal of Hatred
effect: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Morroc's hatred for all living things knew no bounds.

items.name: Crystal of Sorrow
effect: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Every broken heart from Morroc's rampage only served to fuel his power.

items.name: Crystal Shard
effect: A shard of crystal that once made up part of the ocular system of an ancient robot.

items.name: Crystallized Darkness
effect: An enormous and flawless crystal said to be a condensation of the curse that destroyed the ancient kingdom of Glast Heim. Just holding it in your hands makes you feel less alive.

items.name: Cultish Mask
effect: A ceremonial mask used by an ancient shaman. Their ancient rituals promised immortality...and you're starting to wonder if it was that much of a lie.

items.name: Cursed Coin
effect: An invaluable piece of treasure found deep in the Abyss Lake. Legend says it bears a powerful curse, promising vengeance against those who steal it from its subterranean resting place.

items.name: Cursed Key
effect: A magical key created to keep something sealed at the top of the Clock Tower. Originally created by the Lord of the Clock Tower, it ended up becoming her own downfall.

items.name: Cursed Shuriken
effect: A broken and cursed shuriken once wielded by the ghostly Ninja haunting the heart of the Amatsu Shrine. You don't know the nature of the grudge that old ghost bore, but you can still feel its malice emanating from this relic.

items.name: Damaged Circuit Board
effect: A damaged circuit board from an exceptionally advanced android found in the heart of the Verus Ruins.

items.name: Deep Sea Shell
effect: The discarded shell of a creature living in the depths of the ocean.

items.name: Devil's Wing
effect: A small, leathery wing taken from a creature of pure evil. When you hold it, you start seeing visions of Payon Forest...

items.name: Dimensional Jewel Fragment
effect: Shards of a broken jewel. You can sense a strange otherworldly energy among the pieces, but in this broken state, those powers are too weak to accomplish anything.

items.name: Dragon Skull
effect: A large skull taken from a dragon in the depths of the Abyss Lake Nightmare.

items.name: Dragon's Head
effect: The severed head of a terrifying dragon guarding the heart of the Abyss Lake. It almost feels like it is still glaring angrily at you.

items.name: Dream Fragment
effect: A small piece of a dream, a tiny fragment of what could have been, dragged kicking and screaming into the real world.

items.name: Dried Yggdrasil Leaf
effect: A dead leaf shed by the World Tree Yggdrasil. The immense lifeforce flowing through the tree means it is incredibly rare for its leaves to ever reach this state, even decades after falling from the tree.

items.name: Emblem of Valor
effect: An emblem signifying one has overcome great hardship, and has earned the right to battle against impossible odds for even greater glory. Required for the summoning of Challenge Mode MVPs.

items.name: Emerald
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Prontera Field 0...?

items.name: Enchanted Key
effect: A magical key created to keep something sealed at the top of the Clock Tower. Whatever it was originally supposed to be used on, it is now being used to keep the Lord of the Clock Tower trapped there.
items.drops: Clock Tower Manager, the mini boss on the last floor

items.name: Enchanted Log
effect: A wooden log from a tree that refuses to burn, no matter how much heat it is subjected to.

items.name: Enchanted Ore
effect: A strange ore found only on the Bifrost that glows with a mysterious golden light.

items.name: Encrypted Orders I
effect: An encrypted document found off a high-ranking bandit.
But why do bandits carry written orders? And why are they encrypted?
Maybe the Intelligence Officers on Morroc Field 18 can help decipher these.

items.name: Encrypted Orders II
effect: An encrypted document found off a high-ranking bandit.
But why do bandits carry written orders? And why are they encrypted?
Maybe the Intelligence Officers on Morroc Field 18 can help decipher these.

items.name: Encrypted Orders III
effect: An encrypted document found off a high-ranking bandit.
But why do bandits carry written orders? And why are they encrypted?
Maybe the Intelligence Officers on Morroc Field 18 can help decipher these.

items.name: Executioner's Mitten
effect: A glove worn by a torturer that inhabited the Glast Heim Prison. Was she there since the glory days of Glast Heim, or did she arrive sometime after its fall?

items.name: Faceworm Leg
effect: A razor sharp talon cut from a particularly large Faceworm. Unfortunately, it's not quite big enough to use as a weapon.

items.name: Fragment of Agony
effect: A fragment of a green jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible pain.

items.name: Fragment of Despair
effect: A fragment of an orange jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible hopelessness.

items.name: Fragment of Hatred
effect: A fragment a blue jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible hostility.

items.name: Fragment of Sorrow
effect: A fragment of a purple jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible misery.

items.name: Fragment of the Future
effect: A broken fragment of glass which reflects images of a future that will never come to pass.

items.name: Fragment of the Past
effect: A broken fragment of glass which reflects images of a past long abandoned.

items.name: Frozen Coral
effect: Horns taken from a Frozen Stallion that formed to look like an icy version of sea coral.

items.name: Garnet
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Payon Field 11...?

items.name: Ghostly Fabric
effect: A piece ethereal, nearly transparent fabric that seems to be barely real. Holding it in your hands brings back memories of Payon Forest...

items.name: Giant Butterfly Wing
effect: A gigantic wing from a dangerous jungle butterfly.

items.name: Gift Box
effect: A box which contains a gift. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to open anymore.

items.name: Glacial Heart
effect: A heart made of pure ice that once beat at the heart of a massive Ice Titan. It still pulses with frigid energy.

items.name: Glass Bead
effect: A small glass bead found in the Culverts. Highly sought after...at least by mice.

items.name: Glistening Powder
effect: Mysterious powder found in the possession of the fairy guarding the Tower of the Morning. You're not sure what purpose it serves.

items.name: Glittering Diamond
effect: A glittering diamond found in the Sograt Desert, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Morroc Field 17...?

items.name: Glittering Shell
effect: An exceptionally rare insect shell that sparkles with dazzling, almost regal light.

items.name: Gluttonous Fang
effect: A massive tooth torn from the jaw of the monster roaming the sealed halls of Rachel Sanctuary.

items.name: Gnome's Moustache
effect: A moustache shaved off an old gnome that has somehow maintained its entire shape and form.

items.name: Goat Horn
effect: A sturdy and razor sharp horn taken from the greatest of wild goats. Wait, were that goat's horns actually this straight...?

items.name: Gold Ore
effect: A lump of...let's call it ore, that seems to contain some traces of actual gold.

items.name: Golden Feather
effect: A sparkling golden feather taken from one of the little angels roaming around Eclage. It didn't seem to have any feathers when you fought it, so you're not exactly sure where this came from...

items.name: Golden Shell Fragment
effect: A fragment of the carapace-like armor worn by the Scaraba Royal Guard. It's gold sheen seems to be an artistic embellishment rather than any kind of natural coloring.

items.name: Golem Core
effect: The core of a Stalactic Golem. Despite it's outward appearance, the core is surprisingly...fleshy?

items.name: Green Signet Ring
effect: A green signet ring belonging to one of the member's of Thantos Tower's ceremonial guard, a symbol for those with unmatched ferocity.

items.name: Gryphon Talon
effect: A razor sharp talon pried from the foot of a gryphon roaming the grasslands of Arunafeltz.

items.name: Hand of God
effect: A figure of a pierced hand that bears great religious symbolism. It seems it was used in a ritual to bring the dead back to life...though not quite in the same way this artifact would have suggested.

items.name: Heart of Corruption
effect: A large jewel-like object that seems to be acting as one of the sources of Glast Heim's corruption. This particular one has fused with the Nightmare environment of Old Glast Heim's deepest level to become even more potent than it was during Glast Heim's actual fall.

items.name: Iceslug Cluster
effect: A cluster of cells that once made up part of a large iceslug. Though it attacked you like all the other wildlife in the area, it looked dangerously close to being intelligent...

items.name: Illusion Stone
effect: A mysterious ore that forms in places where the world has distorted, though in a very different way to the Nightmare Dungeons. Could this power be the key to overcoming the Nightmare...?

items.name: Iron Ore
effect: Raw, unprocessed ore that contains a great deal of elemental iron. A critical material for the revolution. The Goblin revolution.

items.name: Keycard Alpha
effect: A flat, translucent yellow keycard. You can only guess it's used to unlock something in the Black Ops Base.

items.name: Keycard Omega
effect: A flat and transparent black keycard. You can only guess it's used to unlock something in the Black Ops Base.

items.name: Large Jellopy
effect: A massive jellopy left behind by the true master of all porings. Feels very at home in Payon Forest.

items.name: Live Coal
effect: A live coal that never seems to burn out, no matter how long you leave it.

items.name: Living Stone
effect: A fragment of stone rich in vital energy. It appears to still be trying to grow.

items.name: Lost Letter
effect: ...nothing broke my heart more than having to leave without saying goodbye to you. And so, though I know I have no way of getting it to you, I've written this letter so that maybe, just maybe, I can tell you how much I loved you, and how much I still do. I've written this letter a thousand times, and I'll write a thousand more if I have to. And someday, if God has any mercy at all, one of these thousands of letters will make its way to you...

items.name: Manacles
effect: A pair of handcuffs that were ostensibly used to restrain prisoners once. Though something about these ones reminds you more of torture than of law enforcement...

items.name: Massive Fang
effect: A massive fang extracted from a monstrosity found deep in Orc Dungeon. Whatever is creating these disgusting creatures must be stopped.

items.name: Massive Metal Chunk
effect: A massive piece of scrap metal harvested from one of Juperos's guardians. Despite it's enormous size, it weighs next to nothing.

items.name: Matchstick
effect: A phosphorus tipped stick that can be used to start a fire.

items.name: Mechanical Device
effect: A complex mechanical device developed in Kiel Hyre's Robot Factory. Its true function and purpose is a mystery.

items.name: Megalith Shard
effect: A shard taken from one of the mysterious Megaliths roaming the Comodo Caves. Or...sitting still in the Comodo Caves, I suppose.

items.name: Memento
effect: A box that is buried with the dead. It contains gems and someone's mementos...

items.name: Mutated Cell
effect: A sample taken from an escaped homunculus roaming the canyons around Veins. It doesn't take much scientific knowledge to realize something bizarre had been done to the poor creature.

items.name: Mysterious Luminant
effect: A mysterious mote of light trapped within a gel-like membrane. You have no idea what it means.

items.name: Necklace of Wisdom
effect: A necklace worn by ancient royalty that was supposed to allow them to tap into the wisdom of the gods.

items.name: Neural Chip
effect: A tiny mechanical component harvested from one of Juperos's guardians. Some believe the creature's entire mind is contained in this little device...but that would be absurd.

items.name: Nursing Bottle
effect: Milk that is bottled for infants. Though considering where you got this one, you probably shouldn't try giving it to one.

items.name: Old Hammer
effect: An old, worn out hammer that hasn't seen an anvil in many years.

items.name: Old Hilt
effect: An old hilt broken off the cursed sword Executioner that roams Geffenia. A palpable hatred still emanates from it.

items.name: Old Pendant
effect: An old pendant found in a very ominous place, carried by a very inauspicious creature. It's hard to guess what significance this particular item has, but you can't imagine it's good.

items.name: Old Shuriken
effect: An old, rusty shuriken that was well loved, if maybe not well taken care of, by a ninja turtle. Jury's out on whether it was a teenager.

items.name: Old White Cloth
effect: A worn-out piece of white clothing once worn by the civilians that populated Nameless Island. It's in remarkably good shape considering what happened to the person wearing it.

items.name: Opal
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Prontera Field 0...?

items.name: Orc Trophy
effect: A trophy awarded to the bravest of Orcs.

items.name: Orc's Fang
effect: A cuspid wrenched out of from the jaw of a horrifying undead Orc. Something in Orc Dungeon must be causing these undead to appear...

items.name: Pearl
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Prontera Field 0...?

items.name: Prickly Fruit
effect: A bright green fruit covered in thorns that gives off an unnatural, otherworldly scent. Probably best not to taste it.

items.name: Prismatic Jewel
effect: A brilliantly shining, prismatic jewel extracted from the corpse of the Jewel Worm roaming the Kamidal Mountains.

items.name: Pyroxene
effect: A group of crystalline silicate mineral common in igneous and metamorphic rocks. Symbolizes cure and restoration.
items.drops: Mutant Dragonoid, on its usual spawn point

items.name: Red Gemstone
effect: An enchanted crystal that was once used as a catalyst for particular spells. Now, it only seems to be useful on Mt. Mjolnir...

items.name: Red Prickly Fruit
effect: A bright red fruit covered in thorns that gives off an unnatural, otherworldly scent. Considering where you found it, it is almost certainly dangeorus.

items.name: Red Scarf
effect: A stylish crimson muffler that will make you the envy of alligators everywhere. So it's probably best you don't try and wear it.

items.name: Red Stocking
effect: A Christmas stocking from which presents were stolen through a hole made in the bottom.

items.name: Reins
effect: A set of rings and ropes once used to control the movements of a warhorse.

items.name: Research Chart

items.name: Revenant's Eye
effect: A sinister red jewel carried by the cultists that sometimes pop up in the ruins of Glast Heim. You can only imagine what would draw someone to such a desolate place.

items.name: Royal Jelly
effect: Highly nutritious jelly secreted from honeybees that they only feed to larva and future queens.

items.name: Ruby
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Prontera Field 0...?

items.name: Rusted Sword
effect: An old sword damaged by prolonged exposure to sea water.

items.name: Rusty Kitchen Knife
effect: A dull edged, rusty kitchen knife stained with blood.

items.name: Sandpaper
effect: A rough, abrasive material used to smooth wooden surfaces. Useful someday maybe, but not today.

items.name: Sapphire
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars. This one, however, doesn't seem to have much use.

items.name: Sardonyx
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Payon Field 11...?

items.name: Savanna Blossom
effect: A soft and elegant flower that has somehow managed to bloom despite the arid climate it called home.

items.name: Sea-otter Fur

items.name: Sealed Grimoire
effect: A grimoire that no doubt contains all sorts of heretical and blasphemous teachings...but whatever dark magic was used to seal it, you can't find a way to get it open.

items.name: Sealed Rune

items.name: Serpentine Berry
effect: A strange fruit favored by the Rgan infesting the Far North Tunnels. Those who eat a lot seem to mutate faster.

items.name: Shining Diamond
effect: A shining diamond found in the Sograt Desert, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Morroc Field 17...?

items.name: Shining Sand
effect: A handful of sand with a supernatural sparkle, like a pile of tiny diamonds, produced by the ants of Ant Hell
Maybe there is some use for it in Ant Hell 2...?

items.name: Shining Scale
effect: A shimmering, reflective scale taken from the tail of a mermaid.

items.name: Shrine Amulet

items.name: Skull
effect: A fully intact human (?) skull taken from a powerful skeleton leader.

items.name: Snake's Venom
effect: A bottle of venom taken from a Hebian leader. Are the Hebians connected to the Serpentine Temple somehow? If so, why do they refuse to enter the sanctuary...?

items.name: Solidified Lava
effect: A chunk of lava that has, luckily for you, cooled down enough to be safe to the touch.

items.name: Sparkling Diamond
effect: A sparkling diamond found in the Sograt Desert, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Morroc Field 17...?

items.name: Spider Leg
effect: The leg of a massive spider that lurks on outskirts of the Good Turtle's Village, feeding off its residents.

items.name: Steel Ore
effect: What do you mean there's no such thing as Steel Ore? You're looking at some right now! Maybe you should take it up with the Kobolds.

items.name: Tantan Noodles

items.name: Time Crystal

items.name: Topaz
effect: A precious jewel with weak magical power, often presented as an offering on altars.
Like, for example, the one on Payon Field 11...?

items.name: Ungoliant Leg

items.name: Valkyrie Feather

items.name: Withered Blossom

effect: A lemon colored ore that contains a pale, greenish light. It overflows with elemental Wind energy.

items.name: Wolf Flute
effect: A very tiny flute. It sounds like a wolf tamed by a ranger.

items.name: Ancient Magic Scroll
effect: A tattered, ancient scroll inscribed with formulas for dark, forbidden magics. For better or worse, it is too damaged to learn much from it. Very rare.

items.name: Angel's Tail
effect: The tail of the horrifying Angel Iceslug sealed within the Ancient Altar in the Far North. It's existence is proof that the Nightmare's corruption has spread to every corner of the world. Very rare.

items.name: Badge of Authority
effect: A badge that symbolized the authority of the Emperor, given to those who executed his will. A person bearing this was to be treated with the same respect as the ruler who sent them. Very rare.

items.name: Broken Shield Piece
effect: A fragment of the shield used by the Lord of the Dead.

items.name: Burning Heart
effect: A heart of enchanted stone that emits an otherworldly flame at all times. Very rare.

items.name: Burnt Circuit Board
effect: A damaged component taken from the massive defense robot protecting the ruins of Verus. While it was certainly powerful, it didn't seem like it was in control of the robots roaming the ruined city. Is there some other entity uniting the drones in Verus's defense...? Very rare.

items.name: Clock Gear
effect: A bizarre set of gears from that seem to have been taken from the Clock Tower in Aldebaran. Despite being disconnected from the mechanisms of the Clock Tower, they still spin... Very rare.

items.name: Cogwheel
effect: A cogwheel taken from the heart of the massive mining machine lost deep in the Einbech Mines. You can only imagine what incredible progress it could have achieved if kept out of the hands of those Pitmen. Very rare.

items.name: Covenant's Mark
effect: A pendant bearing the mark of a covenant sworn between the ancient people of Glast Heim and the forces of darkness. One glance at the ruins there is all it takes to confirm just how well that bargain worked out for them. Very rare.

items.name: Crystal of Darkness
effect: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. The endless darkness within it is a perfect reflection of Satan Morroc's vision for Midgard. Very rare.

items.name: Cursed Baphomet Doll
effect: A Doll imbued with Baphomet's curse, or one would suppose. What happened to Baphomet, and how was it replaced by that...thing? Very rare.

items.name: Cursed Ruby
effect: A precious jewel enchanted with a powerful curse.
Very rare

items.name: Demonic Fly Wing
effect: An insect wing found, for some reason or other, on the body of the Fallen Bishop that had sealed himself away in the Nameless Island Monastery. It reeks of a dark, otherworldly power. Very rare.

items.name: Destroyed Armor
effect: Heavy armor plates that have been damaged beyond repair, taken from the guardian robots being tested in the secret military base in Thor's Volcano. The damage makes it hard to tell...but is that a Rekember logo...? Very rare.

items.name: Emblem of Honor
effect: A coin engraved with the sigil of Glast Heim, given out as the highest honor by the king himself. You can only wonder at the past of the horrid monster that was carrying this. Very rare.

items.name: Emblem of the Sun
effect: A small golden bead possessed by the Herald of Dawn. It constantly shines with the brilliant light of the rising sun. Very rare.

items.name: Emblem of Unity
effect: A symbol of solidarity possessed by the leader that united the monsters in Turtle Dungeon. Even as primitive as it is, one cannot deny the beginnings of civilized culture there. Very rare.

items.name: Empty Darkness
effect: A tiny fragment of concentrated darkness with an infinite hunger for all things. Something tells you that if you handle this poorly, it might transform back into the Shadow you took it from. Very rare.

items.name: Encrypted Orders IV
effect: An encrypted document found off a high-ranking bandit.
These seem significantly different than the others.
You should definitely take these to the Intelligence Officers on Morroc Field 18.
(This item is not required to finish the quest)

items.name: Eye of Frost
effect: An exceedingly rare jewel guarded jealously by the abomination sealed deep in the Ice Dungeon. Very rare.

items.name: False God's Emblem
effect: A talisman carried by the evil spirit that attempted to take the remnants of the Serpentine Temple for itself. Though it failed, it's servants still linger, futilely attempting to finish their master's work. Very rare.

items.name: False Heart Fragment
effect: An object that appears almost identical to one of the Ymir Heart Fragments, incredible artifacts that contain unimaginable power. The disturbing energy emanating from this one makes it clear it is an imitation, though it is still dangerously powerful. Very rare.

items.name: Fire Dragon Scale
effect: A pristine, fully intact scale taken from the body of Detardeurus. Though quite solid, it doesn't seem these scales were the secret to his strange immortality. Very rare.

items.name: Forbidden Fruit
effect: A sinister looking fruit cherished by the Herald of Dusk, a demon sealed at the heart of Geffenia. Was she the cause of Geffenia's downfall, or the source of their incredible power? ...or both? Very rare.

items.name: Forbidden Scroll
effect: An ancient scroll covered in mystical and esoteric writings describing the forbidden magics used by the now extinct clan of ninjas that built the Amatsu Shrine. For better or for worse, it's written in a language you don't understand. Very rare.

items.name: Fragment of the Present
effect: A broken fragment of glass which reflects images of a present far more real than this one.

items.name: Gigantic Serpent Fang
effect: A massive, hollow fang taken from a snake that must have been of unimaginable size. Though only barely, there are still traces of the original owner's deadly toxin on it. Very rare.

items.name: Gold
effect: A rare and valuable metal that has become synonymous with both wealth and greed. Very rare.

items.name: Guardian's Bell
effect: A golden bell that once adorned the body of the great serpent guarding the Serpentine Temple. Very rare.

items.name: Hoe
effect: A tool for digging or gardening wielded by a strange goblin deep in the Coal Mines. You can only imagine what it was searching for so far away from the Goblin Village. Very rare.

items.name: Horn of Tendrilion
effect: A stiff horn taken from Tendrilion, the apex predator of the Splendide Fields. It was so powerful that the Lapine had to seal it away in an altar to save the wildlife of the Splendide area, nevermind themselves. Very rare.

items.name: Ice Scale
effect: A thin scale made of ice taken from the great Ice Salamander Ktullanux. It was said he was once tasked by the Sessrumnir Temple to guard one of their darkest secrets, but now it seems he guards something much more dangerous... Very rare.

items.name: Immortal Heart
effect: The still-beating heart of the monstrosity sealed in the Glast Heim Churchyard. Well...one of its hearts. Very rare.

items.name: Kraken's Leg
effect: A squirming tentacle from the massive sea monster that once lived in the depths of Byalan Dungeon. Very rare.

items.name: Lost Sheet Music
effect: A piece of sheet music found in the abandoned Opera House deep in Niflheim. It's written in a form of notation you aren't familiar with. Very rare.

items.name: Mammoth Skin
effect: Rock-hard skin taken from the Mammoth that roams the Manuk Fields. It would make incredible armor if anyone had tools strong enough to work with it. Very rare.

items.name: Mother's Nightmare
effect: A mother's nightmares that have been given physical form. Very rare.

items.name: Nightmare Pitaya Tail
effect: A tail left behind by the bizarre Pitaya monstrosity trapped in the altar in the Juno Fields. No traces of the dark energies powering the creature remain. Very rare.

items.name: Orcish Emblem
effect: An emblem awarded to Orcs of exceptional bravery and strength. Very rare.

items.name: Pharaoh's Mask
effect: A golden mask worn by the ancient king sealed deep within the Sphinx. Morroc's ancient rulers all seemed to succeed in their quest for immortality, but what did it cost them? Very rare.

items.name: Prismatic Keycard
effect: Very rare.

items.name: Pristine Bandage
effect: An ancient but incredibly well preserved roll of bandages. Their holy power is reserved for shrouding those destined to return from the afterlife. Very rare.

items.name: Pristine Faceworm Skin
effect: Perfectly intact skin taken from an enormous Faceworm. No, you can't wear it. That would be disgusting. Very rare.

items.name: Prototype Energy Core
effect: A power core used to give life to the Rogue Prototype that once terrorized the Einbroch region. Very rare.

items.name: Queen's Wing
effect: A fragment of an insect wing taken from the queen of the Scaraba. It shines with a prismatic light. Very rare.

items.name: Rare Gemstone
effect: A clump of ore containing rare, unnatural gemstones. Were these produced by Tao Gunka, or did it bring them here from...wherever it came from? Very rare.

items.name: Robotic Core Fragment
effect: A piece taken from the destroyed core of a highly advanced robot. It's not clear whether human technology will ever advance to this level again. Very rare.

items.name: Rose Quartz
effect: A rare pink mineral that was once prized by the Zealotus of the Glast Heim Prison. You can only imagine where she got something so pretty while living in such a dismal place. Very rare.

items.name: Rough Elunium
effect: Raw, unprocessed ore that contains a significant amount of Elunium. Learning how to refine this could be what the Kobolds need to survive in their war with the Orcs.
Very rare

items.name: Rough Oridecon
effect: Raw, unprocessed ore that contains a significant amount of Oridecon. A more primitive people might try to use it as-is...but it's unlikely they would find much success, Very rare.

items.name: Santa Bag
effect: A large red bag full near to bursting with gifts and presents. Unfortunately, only Santa knows who their intended recipients were...and why Stormy Knight had them in the first place. Very rare.

items.name: Sealed Flame
effect: A vial of enchanted glass containing a furiously burning mote of fire taken from the flame spirit sealed in the depths of Thor's Volcano. It seems to burn with purpose, but you have no idea what provoked its desire for revenge in the first place. Very rare.

items.name: Shining Spear Blade
effect: A shining spearhead that was once used by the Lord of the Dead. Unfortunately it no longer possesses the immense power to take lives it once had. Very rare.

items.name: Tiger Panty
effect: The number of questions this item raises are too numerous to fit in a mere item description box. Very rare. Thankfully.

items.name: Tiger's Footskin
effect: The skin of a tiger, king of the jungle. Or at least the Payon Forest. Or at least he was. Very rare.

items.name: Tongue
effect: A long, sticky tongue cut from an enormous desert beast. Very rare.

items.name: Torn Magic Book
effect: A tattered old book whose pages are crammed full of forbidden dark magics. Or you assume, as it's written in a language you can't read. Very rare.

items.name: Treasure Chest
effect: A treasure box filled with old coins, ornaments and jewelry plundered from ancient and unknown kingdoms. Very rare.

items.name: Tropical Banana
effect: A banana taken from Lady Tanee's own tree. It is no doubt delicious...but eating it feels like a waste somehow. Very rare.

items.name: Valhalla's Flower
effect: A mysterious flower that only grows in Valhalla, the Hall of the Slain. You feel like the fact Randgris carried this flower with her might speak something about her character. Very rare.

items.name: White Snake's Tear
effect: A single tear shed by the great serpent deity worshipped by the original builders of the Serpentine Temple. It sparkles with a divine light. Very rare.

items.name: Will of Red Darkness
effect: A large red stone with seven eyes that track your movement. Maybe it's just your imagination, but they seem to look...hungry? Very rare.

items.name: Wolf's Blood
effect: Blood taken from the colossal beast that once ruled the Audhumbla Grasslands. In a remarkably rare show of cooperation, it took the combined efforts of both the Rachel Loyalists and the Veins Rebels to put the beast down for good. Very rare.

items.name: World Serpent's Catechism
effect: A sacred text belonging to the Jordos Judge guarding the Temple of the World Serpent's entrance. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to contain any clues on how one might enter the Temple itself. Very rare.

items.name: Young Twig
effect: A fresh, young twig that evokes feelings of purity and innocence. Very rare.

effect: A token of hero.

effect: A coin made from 24K pure gold issued by the Kingdom of Rune Midgard. It is used for very special purposes and also has a high collection value.

items.name: Morocc Merit Certificate
effect: A certificate given to people who help rebuilding Morocc.

items.name: Muscovite
effect: A silicate mineral which has a pearly luster. Symbolizes motivation recovery.

effect: An oil that helps on seperating card and equipment. Becuase of the reduced toxic, this oil will prevent equipment from being destroyed or Refine Level from being reduced, thus Increases the success rate.

items.name: New Type Normal Lubricant
effect: An oil that helps on seperating card and equipment. Becuase of the reduced toxic, this oil will prevent equipment from being destroyed or Refine Level from being reduced, thus Increases the success rate.

items.name: Ora Ora
effect: A trap that uses sticky, sweet scented liquid to lure and ensnare Thief Bugs. Handy if bugs are totally infesting a home.

items.name: Peridot
effect: A gemstone which is also called as "Olivine". Symbolizes the peace of mind and wisdom.

items.name: Phlogopite
effect: A pearl gray gemstone which means "like fire". Symbolizes motherly love.

items.name: Premium Reset Stone
effect: There is a rumor this stone able to reset character's stats.

items.name: Rockridge Coin
effect: Common currency in Rockridge Village. It can be used to buy goods from Rock Ridge.

items.name: Schwartzvald Token of Honor
effect: A special Token of Honor from Schwartzvald.

items.name: Seagod's Anger
effect: Relic of Seagod's anger. Nobody knows about the ability of this weapon.

items.name: Singing Plant
effect: A mysterious plant that sings melancholic songs under a full moon. Legend says it's a woman grieving over the loss of her lover that has been reborn.

items.name: Splendide Coin
effect: Lapine tribe coin that stands for "Shining brightly".

items.name: Sweets Festival Coin
effect: Celebration coin for Sweets Festival. Can exchange with sweet treats from Sweets Shop.

items.name: Token of Honor
effect: A special token received from Prontera Castle.

effect: A coin from a treasure chest. Can be exchanged with strong equipment.

effect: A bluish green stone which is commonly used as a gem or an ornamental stone. Symbolizes mental power.
